sources.title: On the automorphism group of a putative Conway 99-graph
supports: The exact target is a strongly regular graph with parameters (99,14,1,2).
The abstract explicitly describes existence as an open problem.
The paper proves conditional restrictions on the automorphism group, not construction or nonexistence.
does_not_support: A status theorem later than the access date.
Any endpoint lattice or Wave 28 novelty claim.

sources.title: Approaching the Conway-99 problem using SAT solvers
supports: A 2026 SAT study still treats the exact graph as an existence problem.
Its reported experiments do not solve the SAT instances in reasonable time.
does_not_support: A complete SAT search.
Construction or nonexistence of srg(99,14,1,2).

sources.title: The Lower Bound for Number of Hexagons in Strongly Regular Graphs with Parameters lambda=1 and mu=2
supports: The exact parameter set is discussed as an existence question.
The contribution is a lower bound on hexagons and structural relations.
does_not_support: Construction or nonexistence of the Conway 99-graph.

sources.title: The Lattice K12 (The Coxeter-Todd Lattice)
sources.inspected_location: NAME, DIMENSION, DET, MINIMAL_NORM, KISSING_NUMBER, PROPERTIES, REFERENCES, GRAM, SIMILARITY
supports: Name K12/Coxeter-Todd, dimension 12, determinant 729, minimum 4, kissing number 756.
Catalogue flags INTEGRAL=1 and MODULAR=3 and supplies Gram and similarity matrices.
Catalogue attribution to Conway and Sloane (1983).
does_not_support: The Wave 28 orthogonal sum with Lambda(F).
Any claimed 21-scaled-dual minimum or discriminant-form comparison.

sources.title: The Coxeter-Todd lattice, the Mitchell group, and related sphere packings
sources.publication: Mathematical Proceedings of the Cambridge Philosophical Society 93 (1983), 421-440
supports: Primary provenance and constructions for the 12-dimensional Coxeter-Todd lattice.
does_not_support: The exact Wave 28 comparison object or endpoint package.

sources.title: The Lattice LAMBDA(F)
sources.inspected_location: NAME, DIMENSION, GRAM, DET, MINIMAL_NORM, KISSING_NUMBER, PROPERTIES, REFERENCES
supports: Name LAMBDA(F), dimension 32, supplied Gram matrix, determinant 1, minimum 4, kissing number 146880.
Catalogue flag Unimodular=1 and provenance references to Koch-Venkov papers.
does_not_support: Evenness as an explicit catalogue property; that is matrix arithmetic or a paper-level attribution.
The Wave 28 orthogonal sum, discriminant-form isometry, frame, projector, or Schur claims.

sources.title: Uber ganzzahlige unimodulare euklidische Gitter
sources.publication: Journal fur die reine und angewandte Mathematik 398 (1989), 144-168
supports: Primary bibliographic provenance for the Koch-Venkov rank-32 lattice family.
does_not_support: The exact Wave 28 orthogonal-sum comparison from the record alone.

sources.title: Extremal even unimodular lattices of rank 32 and related codes
supports: Primary provenance for extremal even unimodular rank-32 lattices.
does_not_support: Identification of every catalogue matrix without a separate isometry check.
The exact Wave 28 comparison.

sources.title: Integral symmetric bilinear forms and some of their applications
sources.inspected_location: bibliographic metadata; propositions checked through exact modern restatements
supports: Discriminant-form technique for even lattices.
Propositions 1.4.1-1.4.2: even overlattices and isotropic subgroups, with residual discriminant quotient.
Proposition 1.6.1: opposite discriminant forms for primitive orthogonal complements in an even unimodular lattice.
Corollary 1.9.4: signature and discriminant form determine the genus.
does_not_support: Uniqueness of a positive-definite lattice inside its genus without an additional class-number argument.
The exact Wave 28 rank-44 census or root-image pattern computation.

sources.title: Gauss Sums in Algebra and Topology
supports: A proof route to the Milgram Gauss-sum formula computing signature modulo 8.
does_not_support: The Wave 28 enumeration of twelve local candidates.

sources.title: Finite quadratic modules and lattices
supports: Finite quadratic modules decompose into indecomposable components and can be realized by explicit lattices.
does_not_support: Realization of a module by a positive-definite rank-44 lattice satisfying the Wave 28 endpoint package.

sources.title: Modular Lattices, Together With A Table of the Best Such Lattices
supports: An N-modular lattice is integral and similar to its dual.
The catalogue requires a similarity carrying the dual to the lattice.
does_not_support: The inference that the weaker containment 21L* subset L makes L 21-modular or strongly modular.

sources.title: On Parity Classes
sources.publication: author-hosted notes; substantially revised in 2003 according to the text
sources.inspected_location: section 2 definitions and the explicit two-neighbor construction later in the notes
supports: Standard index-two sublattice and neighbor bookkeeping.
For suitable parity of a lift, the ordinary one-lattice two-neighbor construction.
does_not_support: A simultaneous transformation of all Wave 28 paired forms and auxiliary endomorphisms.

sources.title: Quadratic Forms
supports: Definition of p-neighbors by equal index p intersections.
Standard connectivity statements under stated local/maximality hypotheses.
does_not_support: The exact simultaneous paired-form Wave 28 package.

sources.title: Kneser's method of neighbors
supports: Standard p-neighbor definition, same discriminant/genus result under its hypotheses, explicit construction, and connectivity results.
does_not_support: A single basis change preserving a Wave 28 tuple of paired forms, a scaled-dual map, and auxiliary matrices.

sources.title: Tight Frames, Hadamard Matrices and Zauner's Conjecture

supports: Nearby, problem-specific relations among tight frames, projectors, and Hadamard matrices.
does_not_support: The real integral 231-vector rank-44 marked-frame package.
The Wave 28 restricted Gram alphabet or cubic-energy equations.

sources.title: Shells of selfdual lattices viewed as spherical designs
supports: Theta-series methods for complete lattice shells as spherical designs.
does_not_support: A selected orientation of 231 antipodal pairs.
The Wave 28 cubic tensor, projector, Schur-square, or exact 46-to-32 pattern result.
